keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Cedar Grove Township, homeowners pay an average of $13,240.7 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 9.97% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 84.1%, assessed values average ~84.1% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 56.4% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 27.4%, and Essex County claims 16.2%.
